title: feat(chat): render when no indexName is passed
body:
**Summary**

in InstantSearch.js rendering of widgets is based on whether the parent index renders it (to avoid rendering with null results). This logic needs to be circumvented for chat.

In React this isn't needed, as we render with artificial results instead.

**Result**

Chat is always rendered, even when there are no results or indexName is not passed.

Example code that now works:

```js
instantsearch({ searchClient }).addWidgets([chat({ agentId })])
```
